verdict.rationale: RudderStack documents warehouse destinations that automatically create a predefined schema for raw event data. Profiles generates warehouse-native SQL that builds identity-resolved customer 360 tables in your own warehouse. Its compliance page says data is stored on your own infrastructure, and a Mattermost user reports 'total control of our data'. missing for 10: no evidence naming Snowflake, BigQuery, ClickHouse, or S3 as supported targets, no documentation of user-controlled sync schedules or frequency, no hands-on corroboration of warehouse loading.
